rationale: The workflow already implements pip dependency caching via the built-in `cache: 'pip'` parameter in `actions/setup-python@v4`, which is the recommended and maintained approach for caching pip dependencies in GitHub Actions. The retrieved evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) demonstrates adding an explicit `actions/cache@v4` step for pip, but this would be redundant and potentially conflicting with the existing cache mechanism. No other evidence-supported optimizations apply: the workflow already has concurrency cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), a reasonable timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT would need historical data), runs as a single job (not a matrix for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), has no scheduled triggers (P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE inapplicable), and uses KinD/Docker images that are pre-loaded rather than Bazel builds (P-LIT-BAZEL-* inapplicable). The current configuration preserves all intended test coverage and required checks.
